posts.title: 2025 is the Year of Linux Desktop, at least for me
posts.description: In this last minute of 2025, I just want to say that : 2025 is the Year of Linux Desktop Well, at least for me. Because you know what? This year, 3 of my friends are converting to Linux, totally. And this is an amazing thing for me.
